scripts.build: pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:dom
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @bycelium/propagation-math test && pnpm --filter @bycelium/evidence-diagrams test && pnpm --filter @bycelium/evidence-diagrams-dom test && pnpm --filter @bycelium/evidence-diagrams-demo test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @bycelium/propagation-math typecheck && pnpm --filter @bycelium/evidence-diagrams-dom typecheck && pnpm --filter @bycelium/evidence-diagrams typecheck && pnpm run check:demo
scripts.check: pnpm run test && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:package && pnpm run test:dom-package
